description.value: Combinations of strong contrasts between light and dark combined with subtle but powerful sound effects presents this character in a way that instantly garners both respect and fear. When you @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.actions.Item.o8lqmFexiwcaLpu3]{Set the Spotlight} on yourself, you can @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.actions.Item.ttL2TstfSqOyzCd2]{Cast a Role} to apply the horror role to yourself as a free action. As long as you are in a spotlight with a horror role, you can use Performance in place of Intimidation to [[/act demoralize skill="performance"]].
